name: Vidisha
reviewOutcome: Official local registry/service evidence exists, but live parcel integration is unqualified.
custodianAssessment: Vidisha district Government of Madhya Pradesh identifies the Revenue Department Land Records organization as maintaining survey-number land records and directs users to WebGIS 2.0. DILRMP is recorded only as national coverage/status evidence, not as the local parcel-serving registry.
queryOutcomes: English and Hindi discovery queries found the official district land-record service, the official national service directory, and DILRMP Vidisha status. No search result supplied a usable Vidisha parcel geometry endpoint.
requestOutcomes: Four bounded public requests were attempted against the official/current and legacy MP Bhulekh hosts. HTTPS WebGIS 2.0 timed out on the initial GET and a shorter retry; the legacy host and HTTP retry also timed out. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS disablement, or unsafe field request was used.
endpointInspection: Not reached: the official viewer HTML/JavaScript/configuration was unavailable before transport timeout, so schema, CRS, API route, and anonymous ID+geometry behavior could not be inspected.

geometryEvidence.reason: No unchanged native geometry response was received.

scopeLimits: DILRMP reported digitization/georeferencing counts are district/tehsil status evidence, not proof of a parcel hit at the exact WUP point.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, or timeout is not evidence of citywide absence.
No citywide polygon completeness, urban boundary alignment, CRS, or stable native parcel identity was verified.
No source integration or adapter admission is claimed.
uncertainty: High for live service behavior and parcel identity/geometry; moderate for existence of a government cadastral service because official district and DILRMP pages document it.
recommendedDisposition: Hold for serial reviewer retry and independent adapter qualification.
